verdict.rationale: The Banking API docs confirm a business can hold more than one Ramp Checking Account (WALLET_ACCOUNT, "A business can have more than one"), alongside an investment account, so multiple checking accounts are evidenced. Nothing shows rules that automatically split incoming deposits across those accounts. Auto top-up with target balances and the "80% of bank transfers automated" claim describe funding and transfer automation, not deposit allocation. Missing for 10: documented self-serve creation of checking sub-accounts, rules to auto-allocate incoming deposits by percentage or amount across sub-accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
